content: NovaOps culture: High standards, collaborative, supportive, clear separations of concern. Team members are autonomous, proactive, take ownership of domains. "Be yourself" approach with trust as north star. Bleeding edge R&D with blend of analytical, creative, and strategic approaches. Roles span strategic advisors, technical builders, and creative collaborators.
All conventional/astronomical names taken. Need to think more abstract, conceptual, or unconventional while maintaining professional quality suitable for cutting-edge R&D team leadership.
Names taken so far: Stellar, Orion, Photon, Atlas, Vector, Polaris, Catalyst, Prism, Vertex, Flux, Protocol, Axiom, Nexus, Synapse, Echo. Need increasingly creative/unconventional options.
Taken names: Stellar, Orion, Photon, Atlas, Vector, Polaris, Catalyst, Prism, Vertex, Flux, Protocol, Axiom, Nexus, Synapse, Echo, Resonance. Need to explore deeper into unconventional territory.

Update: Stellar, Photon, Protocol are now available. Also all recent creative options (Palimpsest, Chrysalis, Liminal, Parabola, Tesseract, Palindrome, Symmetry, Phase, Archetype, Hermes) are available.

All names available: Stellar, Orion, Photon, Atlas, Vector, Polaris, Catalyst, Prism, Vertex, Flux, Protocol, Axiom, Nexus, Synapse, Echo, Resonance, Palimpsest, Chrysalis, Liminal, Parabola, Tesseract, Palindrome, Symmetry, Phase, Archetype, Hermes. Choosing identity for NovaOps collaborative partner role.
Correction: "hills" = "HITLs" (Human In The Loop) - not a typo. Chase and Greta are the only HITLs (Human In The Loop) in the organization, providing human oversight and guidance for AI agents.
